'''Law and crime'''
*[[2020–2021 Thai protests]]
**[[Thai people|Thai]] pro-[[democracy]] activist [[Arnon Nampa]], who led protests in 2020 and 2021, is [[sentence (law)|sentenced]] to four years in prison on a [[criminal charge|charge]] of [[Lèse-majesté in Thailand|royal insult]]. [https://time.com/6317402/arnon-nampa-thailand-protest-lese-majeste-sentence/ (''Time'')]
*[[Criticism of Amazon]]
**The [[Federal Trade Commission]] and 17 [[U.S. state]]s file a [[lawsuit]] against [[Amazon (company)|Amazon]] over accusations of [[monopoly]]. [https://www.npr.org/2023/09/26/1191099421/amazon-ftc-lawsuit-antitrust-monopoly (NP)]
'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 United Auto Workers strike]]
**[[President of the United States]] [[Joe Biden]] visits [[strike action|striking]] [[United Auto Workers|UAW]] workers near [[Detroit]], [[Michigan]], becoming the first sitting American president to join a union [[Picketing|picket line]]. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2023/09/26/biden-uaw-picket-line-michigan/70969139007/ (''USA Today'')]

[https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2023/sep/26/daniel-dan-andrews-resigns-quits-retires-victoria-premier-update-announcement (''The Guardian'')]
